description: Compares two versions of a DESIGN.md file the way `npx @google/design.md diff` does. Best for: deciding whether a DESIGN.md change is breaking before it is merged. Pass the whole old file in base_text and the whole new file in target_text, each including the YAML front matter; a file path or URL will not work. Returns: every added, removed and modified token in colors, typography, rounded, spacing and components with its old and new value, breaking (true when a token was removed), regression (true when the new file has more lint errors or warnings), the lint counts before and after, and a markdown summary. Do not use for: checking a single file (use lint_design_md) or comparing two websites (run extract_design_md on each first).

examples.base_text:
---
name: Demo
colors:
  primary: "#1A1C1E"
  surface: "#FFFFFF"
  secondary: "#5C5C57"
---

base_text.description:
The whole old (current) DESIGN.md file contents, including the YAML front matter between --- lines. Not a file path or URL. Example: "---
name: Paper
colors:
  primary: "#1D1D1B"
---". Both files together must stay under 64 KB.

target_text.description:
The whole new (proposed) DESIGN.md file contents, including the YAML front matter, to compare against base_text. Not a file path or URL. Example: "---
name: Paper
colors:
  primary: "#0B5CAD"
---".

name: diff_design_md

breaking.description: True when a token was removed, so references to it stop resolving

from.description: Old value; absent for an added token. Colors are lowercase hex, dimensions are CSS lengths, typography is "family size/lineHeight weight", and a component is "property: value" pairs joined by commas

to.description: New value in the same format as from; absent for a removed token

markdownSummary.description: The changes as a short markdown report

regression.description: True when the target has more lint errors or warnings than the base

tokens.description: Token names added, removed and modified per group, as `npx @google/design.md diff` reports them

title: Diff two DESIGN.md files for token changes and lint regressions
